item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q020_syntaxin_fragment_reclassification","answer":"In current SCOPe release 2.08, 1br0 chain A (d1br0a_, sunid 17772), all three 1ez3 chains (d1ez3a_/b_/c_, sunids 17768–17770), and 1dn1 chain B (d1dn1b_, sunid 302344) all have SCCS a.47.2.1: all-alpha class a, STAT-like fold a.47, t-SNARE superfamily a.47.2, and t-SNARE family a.47.2.1. Thus the early 1br0 and 1ez3 constructs should be interpreted as incomplete observations of the homologous syntaxin N-terminal/Habc domain whose complete context is seen in 1dn1 B—not as autonomous domains or independent evidence for a separate fold. SCOPe’s whole-chain domain records for those fragment constructs classify the coordinates present; they do not certify biological domain completeness. This is chiefly a reinterpretation of the fragment records rather than a new SCCS reassignment: release 1.55 already placed all three structures in a.47.2.1.\n\nFamily-level co-classification supports homology among these syntaxin/t-SNARE N-terminal domains more strongly than mere fold similarity. It does not mean that every protein assigned only to the STAT-like fold a.47 is homologous, nor does a short three-helix match justify syntaxin identity or transfer of partner binding, regulation, conformational state, or detailed function. Those transfers require full-domain sequence coverage, domain-boundary and complete-structure comparisons, and biochemical evidence. For full-domain modeling or representative selection, prefer a complete, nonredundant structure over 1br0 or the three crystallographically redundant 1ez3 copies; fragments remain useful only as local templates for their covered regions. Moreover, 1dn1 is obsolete in favor of 3c98, whose chain B is also a.47.2.1, so 3c98 B is the preferable current representative when suitable. Do not conflate 1dn1/3c98 chain A, which SCOPe assigns to e.25.1.1, with the syntaxin domain.","evidence_used":["pretrained model knowledge","/api/v1","/api/v1/","/api/v1/releases","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1br0","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1ez3","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1dn1","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1br0/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1ez3/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1dn1/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/d1br0a_","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/d1ez3a_","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/d1ez3b_","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/d1ez3c_","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/d1dn1b_","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/a.47.2.1","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/47664","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/311131","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47663","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/191190","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47662","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47661","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47654","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/46456","/api/v1/releases/1.55/pdb/1br0/domains","/api/v1/releases/1.55/pdb/1ez3/domains","/api/v1/releases/1.55/pdb/1dn1/domains","/api/v1/releases/1.75/pdb/1br0/domains","/api/v1/releases/1.75/pdb/1ez3/domains","/api/v1/releases/1.75/pdb/1dn1/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.07/pdb/1br0/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.07/pdb/1ez3/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.07/pdb/1dn1/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1br0/chains","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1ez3/chains","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1dn1/chains","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1br0a_","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1ez3a_","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1dn1b_","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/3c98/domains"]}]}
